opening.argument: The presentation is plainly framed as an ABP News election interview and public political discussion: the host states, “Hello friends you are watching ABP News I am with you, Shobna Yadav,” and places the discussion in the election context by saying, “It is the election on February 8.” The free-electricity statement is a political promise, not an investment or wealth-return offer: viewers are told, “You're going to have 200 units of electricity free for five years,” while public-service achievements are discussed alongside requests for votes, including, “I built a school, so vote. I built a hospital, so vote.” The subscribe prompt reflects ordinary channel engagement, and nothing described involves payment, a private-data request, or a transaction outcome.
